severity.P0: destructive data risk, security/privacy, safety, unrecoverable action or app-wide blocker
severity.P1: blocks or seriously confuses a normal household journey
severity.P2: meaningful UX/copy/IA inconsistency without blocking completion

findings.title: Phone-only reset could reset the shared Josh + G household
findings.evidence: Browser reproduction captured a household PUT after Start the kitchen over with kitchenReady=false, weekStatus=unplanned, history=[] and ratings={} even though the sheet said this phone.
findings.decision: Remove user-accessible reset until shared reset is deliberately designed.

findings.title: Clean additional device is falsely classified as conflicting local data
findings.evidence: Fresh zero-filled V12 stock objects are truthy to meaningfulPayload(); clean-join browser run showed This device already has Home Meals data.
findings.decision: Ignore untouched/default/zero scaffolding when deciding whether local state is meaningful.

findings.title: Expired G session shows Connect Josh + G and the Josh guide together
findings.decision: Central entry coordinator; auth owns the screen before onboarding.

findings.title: Sync conflict and Kitchen setup can stack simultaneously
findings.evidence: Reproduced the real screenshot class in Chromium with both high-attention decisions active.

findings.title: Fresh G sees talking-head guide over legacy Home onboarding
findings.decision: G guide becomes the sole G first-use teaching experience.

findings.title: Fresh Josh can see Home first-run and FirstRunKitchen together
findings.decision: Give Josh one minimal setup path.

findings.title: No single arbiter owns entry/setup/recovery layers
findings.decision: Order: auth/code > person > sync > first-use > Kitchen > ordinary sheets.

findings.title: Conflict resolution is too opaque for an overwrite decision
findings.evidence: state should win / become canonical with Use shared household / Keep this device and no useful difference summary.
findings.decision: Normal language plus meaningful differences and last-change context.

findings.title: Leftovers are promised but not persisted as a household object
findings.evidence: Cooking copy promises two leftovers; current observation writes leftoverWeightG=null and no portion/location lifecycle exists.
findings.decision: Preferred: explicit remaining portions + Fridge/Freezer/None + later consumption.

findings.title: Internal engineering language appears across active UI
findings.evidence: Examples include Kitchen truth, canonical, qualitative, repertoire, reconciled, packet equivalents, production batch, storage packet, source-tested formulation and reference minutes.
findings.decision: Full active-surface human-language rewrite plus regression gate.

findings.title: AI layer is not strongly fenced from internal vocabulary
findings.decision: Reason over technical context; final user language must be natural household English.

findings.title: From what we have builder is not directly discoverable from Cook
findings.decision: Restore a visible Cook entry without cluttering the page.

findings.title: Dinner photos are device-local while other couple memory is shared
findings.decision: Make this an explicit product decision; preferred direction is bounded shared household photo memory.

findings.title: Prep and Help often explain machinery before the household action
findings.decision: Lead with what to do; preserve detailed measurement rules underneath.

findings.title: Vision presentation reads like model diagnostics
findings.decision: Keep confidence and confirmation behavior; humanize labels and actions.

findings.title: Offline promise may be broader than guaranteed cache coverage
findings.decision: Narrow copy or proactively cache the week/needed dynamic recipe routes.

findings.title: Guide behavior is sound but some copy still sounds like the data model
findings.decision: Include all guide dialogue in the human-language pass.

findings.title: Josh reaction assets use mixed 112px and 80px source dimensions
findings.decision: Inspect on real iPhone and normalize only if sharpness/apparent scale changes are visible.

verified_passes: representative active routes return successfully without browser page errors
no horizontal overflow observed on representative 390px routes
no broken loaded images observed on representative routes
fixed CTA and persistent Home dock clearance holds on sampled short-phone routes
smart Ask Home produces one active dialog in the configured-AI path
Plan Shop mode can add checked purchases to Kitchen
cooking reaches Done and writes a history event
sampled visible controls have accessible names and at least 44px geometry
typed AI and Vision remain confirmation-first
guide replay, detours and reduced-motion have acceptance coverage
